Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

rank noun

a grade in the army

also military rank, promote to higher rank

classical

Cic. Lael. 12: ex tam altō dignitātis gradū (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 187

gradus, gradūs m.

noun, fourth declension

a rank, a degree, a step

Classically a step in rank or standing of any kind, chiefly civil: per omnēs honōrum gradūs (Cic. Cat. 1.28, Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • ōrdō, ōrdinis m. — a centurion’s rank, a command

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Caes. BG 6.40: centuriōnēs ad superiōrēs ōrdinēs trādūcere (Lewis & Short)

    The army’s own word for a centurion’s grade: to promote a centurion is to move him to a higher ōrdō.

Examples

  • ad (in) ampliōrem gradum prōmovēre

    to promote to a higher rankTraupman 187

See also promote, officer.

SourcesLewis & Short: gradus · Lewis & Short: ordo
